I've emailed Aisha the list prices: House Blend 1 kg at €18.40 and Huila 1 kg at €24.90, per bag, excluding VAT. The email also says volume pricing needs finance approval and that you'll get back to her on it.

I left out the annual spend figure. It comes from the pipeline notes, which are an internal sales document, and we can only send public information to people outside the company. Nikos or Owen would be the people to ask.
